actions.action: If roots mushy, trim rotten roots and repot in dry cactus mix in slightly larger pot, withhold water a week
Move both plants away from cold glass/drafts to bright spot above 15 °C
Finger-test soil 3 cm deep before watering, water only when dry, empty saucer after 10 minutes
Snip yellow/brown oxalis leaves at base

reason: The answer diagnoses cold, wet soil and root rot instead of underwatering. Its advice to unpot, repot into dry mix and withhold water for a week would deepen the plants' thirst and delay the simple fix of watering thoroughly.
